body: U3 is yours: research/TASK_U3.md. Mid tier, effort medium, Fast off. U2 is spliced and marked COMPLETE - thank you, R54 is being built against your AUTHORED ruling. Five questions in the file, Maria's form: options, ruling, written why, refusals. Hold M6 (BAD/AMBER/GOOD and the one badge), M11 (age is ink, wear is recess and never anatomy) and your own U2 - do not reopen any of them. The upgrade over Maria's seat is that you have the repo and the engine: render your boards from the real kit with a Godot/tools/Capture*.gd harness, not mock-ups. Touch no .gd under Godot/scripts - Claude owns Aging/Retention/GameState/ProfileRevampPanel/UIKit on R54 and Codex owns OfficeHubPanel on C37.
